builder.name: Karim: first conversation (lead from YouTube video on Dubai investment)

situation.scenario: The learner speaks with Karim, who came in as a lead from: YouTube video on Dubai investment. Based in Hamburg. Owns one commercial unit and one apartment, both long-term rented. Runs a delivery business. Wife, two kids; parents in Lebanon. Concerned about regional stability; considering property vs. growing the business. Parents may influence decision. Budget 1.8–2.5M AED; timeline 6–9 months.
situation.hiddenTruth:
Held back until the learner earns it:
• Motivation: medium
• What matters most: Market conditions 40%; Best price 30%; Time constraints 30%
• Constraints: risk management; possible golden visa angle for parents
• Areas: Dubai Hills / Creek Harbour (if probed)
situation.agreesWhen: The learner offers: questions about risk tolerance and exit plans; acknowledging family priorities.
situation.declinesWhen: The learner uses: overpromising; ignoring risk.

opensUpIf: questions about risk tolerance and exit plans
builder.whatToExpect: A first call with Karim (German/Syrian entrepreneur), who came in from: YouTube video on Dubai investment. Earn the details before you pitch. Goal: agree to a structured comparison call.
builder.opening: Hallo, yes, Karim speaking. I watched a video about Dubai investment, but honestly I'm not sure property is the right move for me now.
exampleLines: Maybe I should just put the money into my business.
What is the exit if I need the money back in three years?
My parents are in Lebanon, so stability matters to us.
learnerGoals: Agree to a structured comparison call
